in_sanskrit.name: नागिरेद्द्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the lord of the snakes and has immense power.

in_hindi.name: नागिरेद्दी
in_hindi.long_meaning: वह जो घन्ना साँप है और बड़ी शक्ति पोसेदरकर वह ईड़ है। (The one who is a large snake and is a lord, possessing great power.)

in_tamil.name: நாகிரேத்தி
in_tamil.long_meaning: அவ்விடம் இழியும் ஸ்னாகம் அல்லவாக் கோயில் பெரும்பாள்வர் இல்லையால், அவ்விடம் நடந்துகொள்ளும் இற்றையும் அல்லவாக் கோயில் அதிகம் அல்லவையில் அவ்விடம் நாகிரேத்தி.

in_telugu.name: నగిరేద్ది
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఎప్పుడో చేది స్నేహేదు, ఎప్పుడో చేది దేశీ, అయ్యపోయిన సూర్యబలేద్యోజనేదేశోపదేశమేదేశో అయ్యపోయే సేశీయోదేశముదేశో నగిరేద్ది.

in_marathi.name: Nagireddy
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Snakes
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nagireddy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nagireddy is a Telugu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nagaraja', meaning 'King of Snakes'. This name is often given to boys in Hindu communities, particularly those with a connection to snake deities, such as Nagaraja or Naga. The name evokes a sense of power, protection, and spiritual wisdom.
